llm_top3.reasoning: I deviate from the top-ranked names because HIMS news is highly contradictory/volatile and CHTR/TSCO (ranks 3-4) carry clearly negative fundamentals (subscriber losses, guidance cuts). DGX, RNG and UNP each pair beat-and-raise earnings with concrete catalysts — DGX raised guidance plus buyback at a 52-week high, RNG beat with a 67% dividend hike and OpenAI/NiCE AI momentum, and UNP secured CN's support de-risking the NSC merger — giving positive news alignment with decent quantitative standing.
